description: Get an institution's quarterly position-change activity — Initiated / Increased / Reduced / Exited stocks diffed against the immediately prior quarter. Returns the buckets as one markdown section per bucket, sorted by absolute Δ market-value desc (Δ Value includes price movement, not just trading). Use `bucket` to filter to a single bucket. Use this to answer 'what did this fund do this quarter?'

bucket.description: Filter to a single bucket: initiated, increased, reduced, exited (omit for all four)

institutionName.description: Institution name or CIK (a unique partial resolves; ambiguous partials return candidate CIKs)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stocks to return per bucket (default: 20, clamped to 1-500)

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to the holder's latest; an off-quarter date snaps to the nearest report on or before it)

name: GetInstitutionQuarterlyActivity
title: Institution Quarterly Activity
